title: The placeholder bots now come from the Tank Arena crate
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The command-line runner and the viewer now use the Tank Arena crate's Chaser and Wanderer, and the engine's copies are gone, which finishes the first phase of moving tank code out of the engine. The engine's tests use two small test-only policies with their own pinned hashes. Every match plays exactly as before: the same results for 200 seeds, and the same hashes in the browser as natively.
next: the generic engine core (ADR-014 step B1).
